Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
The permissions checked in 2026 apply only to the specified preparations, food uses and conditions.
more_info.overview: Ethyl acetate is an organic ester used as a processing solvent. FDA specifically describes its use to remove caffeine from coffee and tea. That application is subject to good manufacturing practice. A solvent used during extraction has a different role from an ingredient added to provide colour, sweetness or bulk in the finished food.
